description: Master Plan 2019 Building layer is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Urban Redevelopment Authority. Indicative building footprints layer. This layer is extracted from the Master Plan 2019 that was approved on 18 Nov 2019. For the latest Master Plan, please visit URA web site at ura. gov. sg/. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Urban Redevelopment Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
